title: Is the request allowed?
claim: A request passes the deny check, every ceiling and one grant, or it is denied.
alt: A ladder of four questions. Does any policy explicitly deny the request? Yes ends in an explicit deny. Does an SCP or RCP leave the action out? Does a boundary or session policy leave it out? Is an allow missing from identity-based and resource-based policies? Each of these yes answers ends in an implicit deny. Four answers of no end in allow.
